question: Kaziranga National Park is famous for:
solution:
Correct answer is __**One-horn rhino.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** ****Kaziranga National Park** hosts **two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses**, is a World Heritage Site.
 
• Kaziranga National Park is a national park in the** Golaghat and Nagaon districts** of the state of **Assam, India.**
 
• Kaziranga is regarded as **one of the finest wildlife refuges in the world**. 
 
• Kaziranga National Park is also known as an **important birdlife area** by Birdlife International for conserving varied species of birdlife.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca547fe4a894746dd7fccdaae643d6ac431871e57bd2aab43010a39977cfd778.png]

• The largest tiger reserve in India is the **Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve**.
 
• ​The** Darrah National Park** is one of the most popular national parks in **Rajasthan.**** **
 
• Gir forests of Gujarat is the only place where this **race of lions i.e. Asiatic lion is found in its natural habitat**.
